label: Open
description: All fingers straight, thumb alongside.

label: Relaxed
description: A slightly curled, easy hand.

label: Fist

description: A firm half-closed grip, as on a handle.

label: Point
description: Index straight, the other fingers curled.

label: Pinch

description: A half-closed hand, thumb across.

description: A fist with the thumb tucked inside.

description: Index and pinky straight, middle and ring closed, thumb across: horns.

description: Index, pinky and thumb out, middle and ring closed.

description: Thumb and index meet in a ring, the other three straight and slightly apart.

description: Index curled under the thumb, loaded to flick out.

label: Wave 2
description: Pinky and ring curled.

label: Wave 3
description: Pinky, ring and middle curled.

label: Wave 4
description: All four fingers curled, thumb out.

description: The hand in line with the forearm.

description: Bent back and tilted toward the thumb.
